standards.text: The learners demonstrate understanding of the roles of theater artists, theater production processes, professional practices, and ethical standards through apprenticeship experiences within theater organizations and creative industry settings.

The learners synthesize their apprenticeship experiences that reflect knowledge and skills in theater arts, emphasizing artistic, educational, cultural values, and work ethics through work performance and creative documentation. 1
